title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
abstract: arXiv:2611.26603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/

translated_title: Depth Pro 2：清晰且时间一致的度量单目深度估计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Depth Pro 2，一种在完整分辨率下估计图像和视频稠密度量深度的方法。通过分析以往的单目深度估计方法，我们发现它们通常需要在时间一致性与边界清晰度之间进行权衡：多帧方法偏向一致性，单帧方法偏向清晰度。为了克服这种权衡，我们训练了一个单一、可扩展的网络，能够同时处理图像和视频，并以原生分辨率预测深度图。Depth Pro 2 生成的深度图同时具备度量准确性、清晰度和时间一致性，在所有这些维度上都超越了先前的工作。我们发布了一系列模型，在度量精度、清晰度、时间一致性和运行时间方面定义了新的帕累托前沿。我们在 https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/ 公开了代码和模型权重。
tldr: Depth Pro 2 通过单一可扩展网络同时处理图像与视频，生成兼具度量准确、边界清晰和时间一致性的深度图，突破了以往方法在一致性与清晰度之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: Depth Pro 2 trains a single scalable network that processes both images and videos, producing depth maps that are simultaneously metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent, overcoming the trade-off between consistency and sharpness in prior methods.
